save.text: Episode is live; Liam joining remotely (in Bag of Holding joke).
Tekko convention in Pittsburgh on the 8th–10th: Matt and Marisha as guests. (Marisha: college town)
Gilmore's Glorious Goods shirts pre-order deadline confusion: announced deadline 'tomorrow at midnight' (Travis), ambiguity over whether that means tonight; advice to order tonight to be safe.
Two new shirts available for pre-order (limited immediate stock); Crit Role logo on back; working on expanding sizing due to requests.
Sam voice directing DreamWorks cartoon 'Home' (announcement: show exists; releases in a week).
Tonight is episode 47; 50th episode upcoming (three episodes away) with surprises and a Critmas blowout afterward.
Wyrmwood Gaming promo: use code 'critrole' for dice boxes; Laura echoed promo.
Marisha's last episode as host on Signal Boost this Tuesday; she rotates hosts but will continue producing. (Marisha, turns 76-87)
Liam sitting in the kitchen he grew up in and playing D&D in the first room he ever played in. (Liam, turn 94)
Party rested yet to start; they will make camp among Pyrah tribe; Keyleth can't transport them until they sleep. (Matt/Marisha, turns 99-103)
Scanlan casts Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion and offers to shelter entire Pyrah tribe; conjured plane-like mansion with attendants appears. (observed in-play; Scanlan/Sam, Matt)
Approximately 35 Pyrah including Zephrah present; Scanlan offers lodging to all/refugees; tribe hesitates and continues building shelters. (Matt, Sam, Marisha)
Liam (Vax) offered to scout but triggered banter; Vax enters mansion after Keyleth not involved. (Liam, Laura, turns 156-188)

Scanlan's mansion staffed by ~100 spectral servants; Scanlan claims 50 assigned personally, rest available to others. Servants respond to commands and perform tasks (braid chest hair, serve wine, prepare food) and may be intangible (smoke/dissipate).
Scanlan demonstrates servants' consent/dialogue: servant expresses 'purpose' and appears to enjoy service when asked. (Sam/Matt roleplay)
Scanlan has designated rooms: individual rooms upstairs; room at end of hallway slightly larger is Scanlan's; adjacent reserved rooms mentioned for Pike and 'Kaylie' (hypothetical daughter).
Mansion door is invitation-only; Scanlan confirmed servants deny uninvited entry. (turns 280-281)
Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion can be cast once per day; takes one minute to cast. (turns 284-290)

Servants can summon items/creatures within resources: produced one spectral cow (intangible/dispersion on command) and refuse items outside resources (no squid). Servants respond to commands and fetch items. (turns 318-349)
Basement training room discovered: sand pit, training dummies, chains, weapon rack, armor; doorway appeared where none was before. (Matt, turn 360)
Trinket trained with Grog: charged, hit (23 to hit), Grog took 7 bludgeoning, knocked prone; Grog saved STR with 26 and held firm. (Matt, Laura, Travis, turns 384-396)
Scanlan/party have a music room and Sam has a trombone; Scanlan attempted 'sad trombone' sound effect. (Liam/Sam/Matt, turns 430-433)
Vex (Laura) took a magical broom from Gern; broom requires a spoken code word to activate and is inscribed in archaic Draconic meaning 'candle'. (turns 452,474-476,494-501,519-521,523)
Scanlan (Sam) can detect enchantment and investigated broom (Arcana 14, Investigation 21); couldn't read the hidden phrase but identified runes and language. (turns 493,496-501,514-518)

Scanlan offered to use his magic cube to make Vex fly but instead helped find the broom's activation; broom briefly lifted Vex when activated. Vex expressed strong gratitude/affection. (turns 483-486,523-526)
Episode is live; Liam joining remotely (Bag of Holding joke).
Sam directing a trombone/band; Scanlan arranged future good-deed for Vex (mark down).
Tonight is episode 47; 50th episode upcoming with surprises and Critmas after.
Wyrmwood promo: code 'critrole' for dice boxes; Laura echoed promo.
Marisha's last episode as Signal Boost host this Tuesday; she'll rotate but continue producing.
Vax offered to scout; Vax entered mansion after Keyleth not involved (banter).
Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion: cast once/day, 1 minute casting; room is extradimensional ~50 ft high.
Servants can summon/produce items (spectral cow example) and fetch; limited by resources.
Basement training room found: sand pit, dummies, chains, weapon rack, armor; new doorway appeared.
Trinket trained with Grog: charged, hit (23); Grog took 7 bludgeoning, knocked prone; Grog saved STR with 26 and held firm.
Music room: Scanlan/party have a band; Scanlan cued Flight of the Bumblebee while Vex practiced broom flying.
Vex stole/activated magical broom; requires code word in Draconic 'candle'; briefly lifted Vex; she successfully flew (Dex check 20) while exhausted.
After flight, Vex feels guilty about stealing broom and Scanlan pledged to have her repay kindness later; Scanlan 'marked that down.'
Characters settled to rest; later Keyleth awoken by knock—Cerkonos visits; his previously burned-off arm is visibly regenerating and partially presentable.

Cerkonos (headmaster of Pyrah) confides to Keyleth: a young woman, Raishan, came to Pyrah ~4 years ago (~age 15), later grew distant, opened a Gate and helped summon Thordak; Cerkonos blames himself. Pyrah believed she seemed human but unsure of true nature. Offer of Pyrah aid to Keyleth. Keyleth to watch for name Raishan.
Keyleth/Vox session: Raven Queen vision to Vax during sleep—offers choice 'Rebirth or ruin...' and plucks a fate-thread; Vax falls into darkness. (Dream sequence occurred while resting.)
Grog's dream: gladiatorial hall, told 'Release me', drew cold dark blade and fought, enjoyed the thrill—occurred during same sleep period.
Grog dream continuation: Kevdak praising Grog atop corpses; Grog woke with sand/grit on face (morning after rest).
Morning in Scanlan's mansion: extravagant breakfast; Trinket present and messy; group discusses testing if items persist in mansion (Trinket/broom test planned).
Vex admits she stole a magical flying broom from a necromancer (Gern); she intends to keep and use it; group reactions mixed. Percy asked to examine broom.

Vex demonstrated flying broom; fired arrows while airborne (one hit turkey); struggled with stability; Percy will design a seat/aid and may need payment—Vex offers money. Group agrees she should practice; Scanlan reminded Vex to use broom only for good (Sam confirmed).
Morning in Scanlan's mansion continued: Vex floats on broom during breakfast; Keyleth emotionally reactive (drunk/concerned); group eats chickens; Trinket present earlier.

Vex insists she's come to terms with death and is willing to risk flying; Keyleth worries she might die again; leadership banter about responsibility and greed. Scanlan earlier had noted Vex would repay kindness later. (reaffirmed pledge to use broom responsibly).

Cerkonos reported Raishan infiltrated Pyrah ~4 years ago as a ~15yo 'human' who later opened a Gate and helped summon Thordak; Pyrah realized too late and blames themselves—Keyleth told the group. (turns 603, 819-841)
Group confirmed Raishan is closely aligned with Thordak/instigator of rift events; Keyleth says she likely aided dragon entry and then went to Emon. (turns 834, 841-845)

Party discussed immediate plans: possible destinations include Whitestone (sphinx/sphinx's boyfriend), retrieving Titanstone Knuckles from Kevdak/tribe, or visiting a library; Grog's brass knuckles still not obtained. (turns 875-886, 878-886, 872)

Party decides to travel to Westruun region (toward Grog's herd and Frostweald) as next destination; consensus to go there. Grog confirms herd wanders Silvercut Roadway west of Westruun, south of Kraghammer, east of Emon. (~6 herd members).
Grog's herd history clarified: Grog left after refusing to kill a harmless old man; fought cousin, then was beaten and presumed dead by herd—possible lingering animosity. (turns 925-937, 930-936)

Plans/ideas for finding herd: use wolf trackers—Trinket, Keyleth wildshape (she can turn into a wolf), or Whitestone wolf; Hat of Disguise suggested to conceal Grog temporarily. (turns 951-961, 943-946)
Party decides to travel to Westruun/Frostweald region; consensus to head toward the sphinx/Frostweald first. (They discussed trees, Crossroads, Bramblewood as navigation options.)

Plan/ideas for finding herd updated: Frostweald and Crossroads/Bramblewood noted as nearby tree locations; Marisha failed Int check to recall a specific tree in Frostweald. Vex's broom travel proposed.

Grog's herd context reinforced: Gatshadow (north of Westruun) noted as dragon-occupied; Westruun under dragon surveillance—travel risks discussed. Party considering one-on-one approach with goliaths vs. theft of vestiges.

Party used Keyleth's Wind Walk to travel as mist from Bramblewood toward Westruun; spotted an open green field with a small 15–20 ft disturbed dirt mound containing wooden spikes, glimmering objects, large grooves, and two people removing a cart. (turns 1112–1116)

Party used Wind Walk to scout Westruun outskirts, found 15–20 ft disturbed mound with wooden spikes, coins, and sweeping claw marks — identified as dragon offerings; two humanoids hauling a cart noticed removing items. Vex and Vax confirmed offerings/dragon evidence. (turns 1116,1119–1126)

Party circled outside Westruun observing farmlands: some intentionally burned, others functional. Perception revealed armed guards watching individual farms and thin battlement-like wall around city entrances; two guards were directly intimidating farmers at a distant farm. (turns 1132–1141)

Group chose to descend and investigate a corn/high-crop field. Several PCs (Percy, Vax, Vex, Scanlan, Keyleth, Grog) resumed physical form and all succeeded stealth checks, with Vex casting Pass Without a Trace (+10). They aim to approach the farms/offerings area covertly. (turns 1161–1192)

Party used Wind Walk to scout Westruun outskirts; found 15–20 ft disturbed mound with wooden spikes, coins, and sweeping claw marks—dragon offerings; two humanoids hauling a cart removing items. Confirmed by Vex and Vax. (turns 1116,1119–1126)

Party circled outside Westruun observing farmlands: some burned, some functional. Perception noted armed guards watching farms and thin battlement-like wall around city entrances; two guards intimidating distant farmers. (turns 1132–1141)

Group approached cornfield covertly to observe farms/offerings. PCs (Percy, Vax, Vex, Scanlan, Keyleth, Grog) succeeded Stealth; Vex cast Pass Without a Trace (+10). A farmer (Reginald, ~50yo, bruised face) approached within ~15 ft and revealed: guards take people (including his daughter), often half-orcs; dragon seen ~every couple days, last at dusk yesterday. Farmer pointed toward city/edge where captors operate. (turns 1192–1271)
